hub.title: Teaching hub
hub.subtitle: Build everything for one class and subject in one place: topics, what students read, your teaching notes and questions.

banner.text: Build each topic’s lesson in one place — what students read, your teaching notes and the questions.
banner.action: Build lessons in the Teaching hub

hub.readOnly: You can look at this subject but not change it.
hub.livePublished: Students can already see this unit — what you save here shows to them straight away.

pick.title: Which class, subject and unit?
pick.hint: Pick the class and subject you teach, then the unit to work on.
pick.subject: Subject
pick.noUnits: This subject has no units yet. Add the first one below.
pick.noClasses: You don’t have any classes to teach yet. Ask the office to give you your classes and subjects.

unit.deleteMessage_other: “{{name}}” and its {{count}} topics will be removed, with what students read for them. This can’t be undone.

topics.title: Unit topics
topics.none: No topics in this unit yet. Add the first one.

camera.noCamera: We couldn’t open the camera on this computer. You can choose a photo instead.

library.title: Add from library
library.hint: Pick something already shared. Notes are copied into this topic with their files; videos and links are added as links.
